message: Done: your ae5a21241a folded into this change and 68159, with your Signed-off-by. One change: from LU-20722 the link test is on presence, because the ring sends a link bigger than LFU_LINK_MAX as presence only, and an object read only in part is not demoted. On a new filesystem, mountdata and the update log are no longer visible.
Done, your fix. A 1000-byte DoM-only file now reports 1000 and matches -size 1000c.
